top_signals.title: Vitol Paid Out $75 Million to Trader Convicted of Corruption
top_signals.summary: Vitol Group paid $75 million to buy out a former employee who was charged with conspiring to bribe government officials — and kept making the payments even after his landmark corruption trial, according to court documents.

top_signals.title: Wealthy Investors Flock To Oil & Gas Assets Amid Energy Crisis
top_signals.summary: The U.S. and global economies have continued to mint high-net-worth individuals at a historic clip, with wealth intelligence firm Altrata noting that the combined wealth of the world’s billionaires jumped 12.8% Y/Y to a record $15.1 trillion in 2025. The ranks of the “Three Comma Club” hit a record 3,795 people as the AI boom turbocharged wealth creation across the globe. top_signals.title: Mexico Tourism Hit by Falling Beach Visits from Big Spending Foreigners
top_signals.summary: Mexico is trying to figure out how to reignite growth at its once-booming beach destinations, where visits by big-spending travelers have slowed in another bleak sign for a struggling economy.
